damage.proficiency: Apply Proficiency to one listed damage die. Roll the Proficiency Die once per Proficiency rank and each other listed die once.
damage.playerCritical: Double the normal damage dice; add flat modifiers once.
damage.keeperCritical: Use the maximum result of the normal damage dice; add flat modifiers once. Resolve normally against thresholds and Armor Slots.

armorRecovery.shortRest: Repair Armor restores 1d4 + Tier spent Armor Slots.
armorRecovery.longRest: Repair All Armor restores all spent Armor Slots.

checkNotation: Parent Trait (Subtrait) Roll; subtraits use the parent Trait score and are not additional Traits.

sleepingMystic.startingArchive: Two different Domains at Level 1; every Level 1 Power in both.
sleepingMystic.breadthRequirement: Two different Domains at the immediately preceding level.
sleepingMystic.critical: Regain every Resolve spent on the invocation; Fear and non-Resolve costs remain.

conditions.Bleeding: Mark 1 Stress at the end of each round until stopped. Targets that do not bleed, including most Synthetics, are immune.
conditions.Blinded: Disadvantage on attacks and Instinct rolls.
conditions.Confused: On your Spotlight, act against the nearest creature or as the source specifies.
conditions.Cornered: Cannot move out of Melee with the cornering character; Disadvantage on Agility and Finesse rolls.
conditions.Dazed: Disadvantage on the next single action.
conditions.Fleeing: On your Spotlight, move away from the source by the most direct safe route and take no aggressive action against it.
conditions.Frightened: Disadvantage on rolls against the source and cannot willingly move closer.
conditions.Hidden: Cannot be directly targeted by ranged attacks; Advantage on the next attack from cover.
conditions.Incapacitated: Cannot take actions, reactions, or movement; not Dying. Damage hits automatically.
conditions.Infected: Persistent wound or contamination; source defines symptoms and treatment.
conditions.On Fire: Take 1d4 damage at the end of each round until extinguished.
conditions.Poisoned: Mark 1 Stress at the end of each round until treated or duration ends.
conditions.Prone: Disadvantage on attacks; ranged attackers have Advantage.
conditions.Restrained: Cannot move; Disadvantage on Agility and Strength rolls.
conditions.Silenced: Cannot speak, use verbal-component Domain Powers, or coordinate verbally.
conditions.Weakened: Disadvantage on Strength rolls; damage rolls lose flat modifiers.

unarmedStrikes.inheritance: Ancestry gifts and class features build on this baseline.
